newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian treasury raises 50 mln dinars at auction.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian treasury raises 50 mln dinars at auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury on Tuesday raised 50 million dinars ($46.4 million) at its weekly auction of treasury bills dated May 27, and repaid maturing paper totalling 57 million dinars.
It sold 52-week paper at a 6.8750 percent coupon rate for an amount of 21 million dinars, at 6.9375 percent for four million and at 7.0000 percent for 25 million dinars.
The last time the treasury sold 52-week paper was on April 29 at an average 6.96875 percent rate. ($ = 1.078 Tunisian Dinars)
